title: Game-Theoretic Randomness for Proof-of-Stake
venue: The 4th International Conference on Mathematical Research for Blockchain Economy
note: Full paper following the ICBC 2023 poster on game-theoretic distributed randomness.
abstract: This work studies a game in which participants’ incentives support uniform random choices, rather than assuming that contributors faithfully generate random inputs. It develops the approach for distributed randomness and proof-of-stake protocols. The ICBC 2023 poster and this MARBLE 2023 full paper are two publication stages of the same research project.
summary: Uses game-theoretic incentives for uniform randomness and studies how the resulting randomness can support proof-of-stake protocols.
